nodes.label: Existing Graph Fast Path
nodes.rationale: Reuse an existing graph for natural-language codebase questions and avoid unnecessary rebuilding.

nodes.label: Parallel AST and Semantic Extraction
nodes.rationale: Run deterministic AST extraction and semantic subagent work concurrently to reduce latency.

nodes.label: Query Feedback Loop
nodes.rationale: Persist query answers and outcomes so future graph queries can learn preferred sources, dead ends, and corrections.

nodes.label: Replace on Re-Extract
nodes.rationale: Replace changed source content before merging so stale nodes do not survive incremental updates.
